mapper.sql: NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deleted_student d WHERE d.student_id = a.student_id) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM answer ans LEFT JOIN judgment j ON j.answer_id = ans.id WHERE ans.attempt_id = a.id AND ans.submitted_at >= #{start} AND ans.submitted_at < #{end} AND (j.process_status IS NULL OR j.process_status <> 'FAILED') )
mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS attempt_id, v.title AS mission_title, v.thinking_type, (a.status = 'COMPLETED' AND a.completed_at < #{end}) AS completed, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM hint_usage h WHERE h.attempt_id = a.id AND h.opened_at < (SELECT min(f.submitted_at) FROM answer f WHERE f.attempt_id = a.id) ) AS helped_before_first_answer, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM followup fu WHERE fu.attempt_id = a.id AND fu.created_at < #{end}) AS received_followup, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM answer r WHERE r.attempt_id = a.id AND r.followup_id IS NOT NULL AND r.submitted_at < #{end} ) AS revised, (SELECT max(l.submitted_at) FROM answer l WHERE l.attempt_id = a.id AND l.submitted_at < #{end}) AS last_submitted_at FROM attempt a JOIN mission_version v ON v.id = a.mission_version_id WHERE a.student_id = #{studentId} AND ORDER BY last_submitted_at DESC, a.id

SELECT a.id AS attempt_id, fu.question AS followup, fa.id AS first_id, coalesce(fa.plain_text, '') AS first_text, fa.content AS first_content, la.id AS last_id, coalesce(la.plain_text, '') AS last_text, la.content AS last_content FROM attempt a JOIN answer fa ON fa.attempt_id = a.id AND fa.version = (SELECT min(x.version) FROM answer x WHERE x.attempt_id = a.id) JOIN answer la ON la.attempt_id = a.id AND la.version = (SELECT max(y.version) FROM answer y WHERE y.attempt_id = a.id AND y.submitted_at < #{end}) LEFT JOIN followup fu ON fu.id = la.followup_id WHERE a.student_id = #{studentId} AND la.version > fa.version AND ORDER BY la.submitted_at DESC, a.id

SELECT ans.id AS answer_id, ans.attempt_id, a.student_id, v.title AS mission_title, ans.version AS answer_version, ans.submitted_at, coalesce(ans.plain_text, '') AS text, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deleted_student d WHERE d.student_id = a.student_id) AS deleted FROM answer ans JOIN attempt a ON a.id = ans.attempt_id JOIN mission_version v ON v.id = a.mission_version_id WHERE ans.id IN #{id}
